snippet.title: | TED
snippet.description: There's more health advice available than ever before — and no easy way to tell what’s worth your time. From biotech breakthroughs to smarter cancer screening, physician Dhruv Khullar and microbiologist Zack Abbott examine what happens when science can change who we are — including the potential of reengineering the human body — and what medicine might look like in 20 years. snippet.title: The Wiggly Wonder of Music | Jacob Collier | TED
snippet.description:
Grammy-winning musician Jacob Collier has a name for the feeling that moves through a great piece of music: the wiggle. Watch him break down the idea into its three parts — melody, rhythm and harmony — with nothing but his own voice, a grand piano and Louis Armstrong’s “What a Wonderful World.” Turns out life, like music, was never made to run in straight lines. (Recorded at TED2026 on April 14, 2026)

snippet.title: Lofi Girl x Secret Lair - beats to cast to 💫
snippet.description:
Elevate your games with the ultimate tabletop soundtrack.

Lofi Girl x Secret Lair: beats to cast to brings two worlds together, matching the distinct rhythm of Magic: The Gathering and soothing lofi study music. Soft card shuffles, land taps, and double-sleeved ASMR blend naturally into warm, lofi beats engineered for deep focus. Smooth down the tension of a complex stack, keep your heart rate cool during a tough topdeck, and let every turn flow naturally.

Join Lofi Girl's dad as he shares his passion with his daughter, letting her peek into the art of deck building one card at a time.

Tap in, tune out, and may the best deck win. 🃏🎵

snippet.title: lofi house radio 🌅  lounge music to vibe/chill to
snippet.description:
The bell has rung, work hours are officially over, and it's time to ease into your afterwork energy!

Welcome Lofi Teacher, from the world of Lofi Girl, blending electro sounds and lofi textures to bring you crisp, modern lofi house: the ultimate 24/7 radio stream for when the day ends and you're ready to let go.

When the daily grind is behind you, this stream sets the mood with pure chill vibes, tuning effortlessly between warm lounge music and smooth late-night sounds. Streaming around the clock, the station pairs warm tape saturation with classic four-on-the-floor beats, rolling basslines, and lush pads for the ultimate lounge house experience.

Tune in, cook your favorite meal, and enjoy a well-deserved evening off.

🎼 | Listen on Spotify, Apple music and more
